articles.title: Paper Finds Earth May Have Been Terraformed by "Advanced Extraterrestrials"
articles.summary: A researcher has concluded that life first emerged on Earth — despite an astronomically small probability of such an eventuality. While Imperial College London professor of systems biology Rober Endres claims the emergence of life still could've been the result of chemical reactions moving from highly disordered to ordered arrangements, the researchers propose a far more improbable alternative explanation as well: a highly advanced extraterrestrial civilization delivering life to Earth, as Universe Today reports. Such an explanation would "violate Occam's razor," Endres admitted in his yet-to-be-peer-reviewed paper, but he refused to rule it out as a "speculative but logically open […]

articles.title: Scientists Boast That Their AI-Powered Stethoscope Only Fails Two-Thirds of the Time
articles.summary: A team of researchers in the UK say their AI-powered stethoscope can detect three different heart conditions in just 15 seconds. It also, apparently, can be horribly inaccurate.
